report.scope: Unchanged current production host function; real bundled Three scene/geometry/material/camera/Reflector and OrbitControls math, actual collection/assets/features/settings and optics ShaderPass. Renderer, composer execution, DOM event surfaces and PNG encoder are explicit boundaries. No GPU, screenshot, visual or audible playback claim.
results: Host constructs actual Three geometry/material/camera and uses identity grade by default
Exposure, bloom radius and strength alter actual renderer/pass state with safe defaults restored
Color richness and edge shade enable real grade uniforms; original bypasses the pass
Record dust density changes actual draw range and glow changes PointsMaterial opacity
Record reflection scales actual Reflector radiance and fog remains Record-only across scene switches
Record spectrum height changes actual instance matrices and stays editable with motion frozen
Record spectrum height also changes actual Wave geometry with a frozen clock
All 29 sanitized settings reach the real collection frame without rewriting source settings
Real host routes scene-specific settings to Neural, Horizon and Prism after switching
World tempo scales choreography once while real feature timing and real audio smoothing remain independent
Smoothing changes actual band and spectrum attack at equal real audio inputs
Bass, midrange and treble gains independently scale actual three bands and 64 spectral bins
Zero gains remove Record spectrum response without changing the supplied audio data
Real detector transients are scaled and zero pulse suppresses existing real Prism fronts immediately
Muted or inactive analyser input does not produce forwarded onset events
Motion off freezes Record matrices/rotation/light and real Prism pose despite incoming audio changes
Framing changes real camera distance, unrelated edits preserve it and reset restores intended composition
Resize fits actual camera to preview aspect without clearing advanced settings
Orbit speed reaches controls and only enabled compatible scenes auto-orbit during playback
Low quality preserves explicit look values and intentionally disables costly bloom/reflection
Disposed host stops scheduling/renders and disposes its explicit boundaries
Director optics is the actual production pass between grade and output, default camera remains neutral
setPerformance copies and bounds optics/camera without replacing the saved 29 look settings
Continuous framing preserves manual direction and target without invoking a control reset
Continuous framing clamps Horizon manual near/far distances to the actual composed profile
Prism continuous framing changes only lens zoom, preserving composed camera position
Breathe advances only during active playback and freezes its actual camera under pause and Motion off
Record arc moves the actual perspective camera and can freeze without accumulating drift
Composed Horizon and Prism arc uses bounded zoom/roll while preserving their camera positions
Manual camera gesture wins the hold period and remains stable indefinitely with Motion off
After gesture hold and handback, subsequent Motion off freezes the reacquired camera pose
Partially reacquired camera handback freezes its blend and resumes without a discontinuous jump
Repeated camera undo plus actual OrbitControls update does not drift framing, base settings or neutral pose
Raw Director bands stay real and independent of user bass/mid/treble visual gains
Low quality retains optics using the real lower sample budget and correct preview pixels
Aether uses the same host renderer, real collection asset and sanitized independent lab frame
Aether static form and appearance edits apply while its automatic state remains frozen
Aether receives genuine host band gating and drops transient response when playback is paused
Journey camera waits for playback, then moves and holds the exact pose during pause and Motion off
Turning Journey off restores the manual baseline without cumulative camera drift
Aether Journey yields to camera gestures for five seconds and reacquires smoothly from the manual baseline
Aether Journey gesture priority also holds when the separate Auto orbit setting is enabled
Journey is scoped to Aether; copied Record, Neural, Horizon and Prism retain their neutral camera behavior
Aether keeps explicit appearance through preview resize and really reduces submitted geometry in Low detail
